destinations.title: Discover Albania with Your Hire Car from Tirana Airport
destinations.subtitle: From Mother Teresa Airport (TIA), all of Albania is within easy reach
destinations.intro: Your car rental tirana airport trip unlocks one of Europe's most beautiful and least-discovered countries. Albania welcomes you with crystal-clear Adriatic and Ionian beaches, UNESCO heritage towns, ancient Illyrian ruins and dramatic mountains — all just a few hours' drive from the airport. Here are the destinations our customers love most:

places.name: Durrës — 35 km · 30 min
places.desc: Albania's main coastal city and its most popular beach getaway. Stroll the wide Adriatic sands, step inside one of the largest Roman amphitheaters in the Balkans and enjoy the lively seafront promenade. Perfect for a day trip straight from Tirana Airport.

places.name: Berat — 120 km · 1h 30min
places.desc: A UNESCO World Heritage town and one of Albania's most photographed spots, nicknamed the 'City of a Thousand Windows.' Its well-preserved old quarter lines the Osum River, watched over by a medieval hilltop castle with sweeping valley views.

places.name: Vlorë — 150 km · 2h
places.desc: The gateway to the Albanian Riviera and where independence was declared in 1912. Framed by clear Adriatic and Ionian waters, Vlorë is the ideal base for the Llogara Pass, the Karaburun Peninsula and the southern coastal villages.

places.name: Shkodër — 110 km · 1h 20min
places.desc: Northern Albania's cultural capital and the doorway to the Albanian Alps. Climb to Rozafa Castle for views over the lake, wander the historic bazaar and use Shkodër as your base for the Accursed Mountains — among Europe's last untouched wilderness.

places.name: Sarandë — 280 km · 3h 30min
places.desc: The jewel of the Albanian Riviera and one of the Mediterranean's best-kept secrets. Explore the ancient ruins of Butrint (UNESCO), dive into the turquoise Blue Eye spring and unwind on Ksamil's white-sand beaches. Ideal for a 4–5 day road trip from Tirana Airport.

rentalGuide.title: What to Know Before You Collect Your Car at the Airport
rentalGuide.subtitle: A quick guide to picking up your car at Tirana Airport

items.title: Documents required for airport car rental
items.desc: To rent a car at Tirana Airport you need three things: a driving license held for at least one year, a national ID or passport, and a credit or debit card for the refundable deposit. EU and international licenses are accepted, with no extra paperwork for most nationalities.

items.title: Age limits and the young-driver rule
items.desc: The minimum age to rent at Tirana Airport is 21. Drivers aged 21–25 may pay a young-driver surcharge depending on the car category. There's no maximum age limit. Every driver must hold a valid license and be named on the rental agreement.

items.title: Insurance and coverage explained
items.desc: Every car in our Tirana Airport fleet includes basic CDW insurance at no extra cost, covering damage above the standard excess. At online booking you can upgrade to Super CDW for full, zero-excess coverage — strongly advised for Albania's mountain and coastal roads.

items.title: Driving in Albania — what to expect
items.desc: Albania's main roads are modern and well-kept. The SH2 highway links Tirana Airport to the city center in about 20 minutes. Riviera coast roads and mountain passes are scenic but narrower — an SUV is the safer pick for off-the-beaten-track routes. Signage follows European standards; speed limits are 50 km/h in town, 80 on main roads and 110 on highways.

home.seoText: Rent Ride provides car rental across Albania, operating directly at Tirana International Airport (Mother Teresa Airport — TIA) and in the city center. Whether you're searching rent car tirana airport for a business trip, a family holiday along the Albanian Riviera, or a longer road trip through the Western Balkans, our modern fleet, clear all-inclusive pricing and dedicated airport meet & greet have made us the choice of thousands of travelers each year. We welcome visitors from Italy, Germany, the UK, the US, Kosovo and beyond looking for reliable, affordable car rental albania tirana airport. Book online in under 2 minutes — free cancellation, instant confirmation, no hidden fees.

items.question: How does booking work?
items.answer: Choose your car, complete the booking form with your dates and details, then confirm. Your confirmation email arrives straight away.

items.question: What documents are required?
items.answer: You'll need a valid driver's license (at least 1 year), an ID card or passport, and a credit/debit card for the deposit.

items.question: Can I pick up the car from the airport?
items.answer: Yes! Pickup and return at Mother Teresa International Airport (TIA) are free. Our team meets you at arrivals — no extra charge and no waiting.

items.question: Is there any extra fee for airport pickup?
items.answer: No. Rent car tirana airport pickup and drop-off are completely free, with no surcharges. The price shown at booking is the total.

items.question: How do I find you at Tirana Airport?
items.answer: After landing, head to the arrivals hall. Our representative waits there holding a sign with your name. You can also call us 24/7 at +355 69 81 45 803.

items.question: What happens if the car breaks down?
items.answer: We offer round-the-clock assistance. We'll send help or a replacement car right away, at no extra cost.

items.question: Can I cancel my booking?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup. After that, a cancellation fee applies.

items.question: Which cars can I find at the airport?
items.answer: Our Tirana Airport fleet ranges from economy cars at €25/day to roomy family SUVs, premium luxury models and modern automatics. Every vehicle is serviced regularly, cleaned before each rental and under 4 years old. Filter the fleet by category, transmission and price on the fleet page.

items.question: Can I drop the car off at the airport anytime?
items.answer: Yes, we accept returns at Tirana International Airport 24/7, public holidays included. Just tell us your return flight when booking and we'll handle the rest. There's no surcharge for night, early-morning or weekend returns.

items.question: Does the rental price include an airport surcharge?
items.answer: None at all — we charge zero airport surcharge. Prices are the same whether you collect at Tirana Airport or our city-center office, making us one of the few car rental tirana airport companies with truly transparent pricing at both spots.

items.question: How far is the airport from central Tirana?
items.answer: Mother Teresa International Airport (TIA) sits about 17 km northwest of central Tirana. On the SH2 highway the drive is 20–25 minutes in normal traffic. With our tirana airport rent a car service you skip pricey taxis and crowded buses and head straight to your destination.
